messages:
mira: FYI I noticed a burst of very short streams and duplicate billing during the canary this morning. Looks correlated with clients sending a `Conn-Update` header immediately after token refresh.

dylan: saw the spike too. console shows resume count + dup charge bump at ~08:12 UTC. Sessions re-open in noisy bursts.

mira: repro trace: trace-9c3b. repro steps: client rotates token -> issues "Conn-Update: id=tenant42;seq=7" -> old socket torn down, new socket opens. router and billing both count as new session before dedupe window.

sam: can you paste a minimal curl?

mira: curl snippet:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <new>" -H "Conn-Update: id=tenant42;seq=7" https://stream.redwood.example/api/v1/events
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy r-inference@3.2.1 -> canary-12 at 08:00

dylan: timeline from proxy: new conn at 08:12:14.120, old conn close at 08:12:14.137, billing events emitted 14.138 + 14.139. router accepted new before aggregator attributed old tokens -> duplicates.

mira: my quick hunch: race between Conn-Update handling and sticky-lease refresh (edge) + aggregator attribution window is too tight.

sam: mitigation candidates: (1) server debounce on Conn-Update per session id; (2) make Conn-Update idempotent with session+seq semantics; (3) extend aggregator dedupe window from 1s -> 3s behind feature flag.

dylan: also console side: group reconnects within short windows so UX doesn't show 20 sessions for a single logical reconnect. PMs keep opening tickets.

console-ui: we can add a "group by session id" mode and a sliding 2s grouping window for live view. will mock up.

mira: proposed debounce pseudocode (feature-flagged):
```
// on Conn-Update
prev = cache.get(session_id)
if prev and now - prev.ts < FLAGS.conn_update_debounce_ms:
  metrics.incr("conn_update_debounced")
  ignore_header()
else:
  cache.set(session_id, {ts: now, seq: seq})
  apply_conn_update()
```
notes: start with 250ms debounce, tunable per-tenant via rollout flag.

sam: add a counter `conn_update_debounce_applied` and a histogram for debounce latency so we can measure false positives. also add unit tests for same-session rapid updates and cross-session acceptance.

dylan: aggregator change risk: increasing dedupe window to 3-5s will slightly delay final attribution but should remove dup-billing. product wants cost impact numbers before we flip it.

mira: i'll open PR for debounce + metrics + flags and a separate PR for aggregator-window behind rollout. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4379 (WIP).

deploy-bot: ops: scheduling canary rollout: conn_update_debounce_ms=250 on canary-12 at 09:30 UTC behind flag.

console-ui: i'll prototype grouped session UI and add a dashboard panel for "deduped billing events" + a trace link so SRE can jump from spike -> example sessions. will increase sample rate for grouped events during canary to 1.0.

sam: please also add an integration test that simulates auth refresh jitter + sticky-lease delay so we can exercise end-to-end.

dylan: once canary is live let's watch metrics: conn_update_debounced, deduped_billing_count, grouped_session_count, and sampling traces for 5m after rollout. if anything regresses roll back flag.

mira: agreed. i'll coordinate with eng-oncall and post trace-9c3b in #eng-oncall if we see anomalies.

console-ui: mockups posted: https://intranet/redwood/designs/session-grouping (will attach after PR).

mira: thanks all, i'll land the debounce PR behind flag and schedule canary.

dylan: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: monitoring: created alert template for bursty-reconnects > 60/min per-tenant (threshold off by default).
